brief:
A Palestinian activist has called for Palestinians to witness the growing pro-Palestine sentiment across America, arguing that the movement reflects a significant shift in global consciousness, according to Electronic Intifada. The piece emphasizes that Palestine has become a central concern for millions of people worldwide.

The activist's appeal reflects efforts to highlight international solidarity with Palestinians, particularly within the United States, where pro-Palestine demonstrations and advocacy have expanded considerably in recent years.
dek: Palestine is now in the hearts and minds of millions around the world.
title: Palestinian activist urges world to see America's pro-Palestine movement
